backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining backend logic for bookings and messages with validation, storage using Maps, and public functions for submitting and retrieving bookings/messages with auto-incrementing IDs.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three QR code-related features: generating a website-specific QR code, updating the Footer component to display it, and rendering it as a static asset.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including components (Hero, Services, About, Booking, ContactForm, Footer, ServiceAreaMap), hooks (useContactForm, useBookingForm), and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system defining CSS variables for light and dark themes with warm orange/amber accents and deep blue-gray primary colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with "Friends AC Services" title, favicon links for 32x32 and 16x16 logo images, and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component rendering the full page layout with Hero, Services, About, Booking, ServiceAreaMap, ContactForm, Footer sections and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/About.tsx: About section component displaying four statistics cards (2+ years, 500+ customers, 100% certified, 24/7 support) with icons and a commitment statement about warranties and EPA certification.
frontend/src/components/Booking.tsx: Booking form component with service type selection, calendar date picker, time slot dropdown, and contact fields (name, phone, email) that submits to backend via useBookingForm hook with validation and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Contact form component with input fields for name, phone, email, service type selector, and message textarea, plus three info cards displaying phone numbers, email (friendsacservices@gmail.com), and Madurai location.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying company info, contact details (phone, email, location), business hours, social media links, and a QR code for the app identifier.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section component with background image, company branding, service description, and call-to-action buttons that scroll to the contact section.
frontend/src/components/ServiceAreaMap.t: Service area map component displaying a coverage map image with an overlay listing served areas and a prompt to contact for unlisted locations.
frontend/src/components/Services.tsx: Services section component displaying four AC service offerings (Installation, Repair, Maintenance, Emergency Service) in a responsive card grid layout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, creating anonymous or authenticated actors and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBookingForm.ts: Custom hook for handling booking form submissions, converting dates to nanoseconds and calling the backend actor's submitBooking method with toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactForm.ts: Custom hook for handling contact form submissions, calling the backend actor's submitMessage method with timestamp conversion and toast notifications for success/error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Custom hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm orange/blue-gray color scheme for light and dark modes, optimized for an AC services brand.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining theme extensions including custom colors using OKLCH color space, typography, container queries, animations, border radius variables, and custom keyframes for accordion animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for an AC services website documenting implemented features including hero section, services listing, contact form, about section, footer, booking system, and various UI enhancements with architectural notes indicating email notifications are disabled.
